title: 12/29/2023 - Software Updates
text:
## 12/29/2023 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097701
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.
We added a new "Reviews" endpoint to the Brilliant Directories API.  Using this API endpoint, Admins can create, update, delete, match, and read Member Reviews.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to use the "Remove File" button related to a File Upload Field in a form in some cases.
We added the ability for members to use the Stock Photo Library Add-On when adding and image to a post from the Member Dashboard for Single Image Post Types . Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Single Photo Upload
We updated the Related Searches widget in order to include related searches related to the member's top level category as long as the member has a top level category selected.
We fixed an issue with the Reviews Homepage Streaming widget which was preventing the "Include Posts from Non-Searchable Member" streaming widget setting from working properly in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Reviews
We fixed an issue with the Bookmark my Favorites Add-On which was preventing the bookmark counter from working properly on the Sub-Account tab in member profile pages in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Add to Favorites Button
The "Membership Plan Name" and "Membership Plan ID" variables have now been added to the Email Variable list shown when editing an Email Template.
We updated the Export Member Data Add-On in order to include the "Product Name" of an invoice when exporting invoices from the Transaction History page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from respecting the "Hide Reviews Star Rating Options" Membership Plan Setting when the "Member Profile - Write a Review" SEO Template has been customized on a site. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Form - Display Rating Options
We updated the Froala WYSIWYG to the latest version available.
We fixed an issue with the Member Post Import logic which was causing the system to add duplicate posts during import after checking the 'Auto Import the posts image base on "Post Image" during import' Setting in some cases.
We updated the Member Transaction History section in the Member Dashboard in order to add support for pagination and sorting the columns.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Filter by Form" field from working properly when searching on the Form Inquiries page in the Admin.
We updated the "Post - Standard" and "Post - Photo Album" webhooks to include the first_name, last_name, email, company, full_name and filename fields as part of the data sent to the webhook endpoint.
We fixed an issue which was causing Member Profile Photos uploaded through the Member Dashboard to distort the images during the upload process on some Apple devices. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Profile Image Upload
We added the support for using the variable name of custom fields found in the Member Leads form as variables in the "3rd Party Email Addresses" fields in the Lead Settings. Widget Involved: System - SaveForm (ID 1382)/html.php
We fixed an issue which was preventing Member Searches from returning accurate location results when the "Localized Search" Advanced Setting was enabled on a site in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Member - Search Query
We updated the robots meta tag to "no index, no follow" when loading the Pretty URL version of a member search results page which does not have any results and the "Google Search Assist" Add-On is enabled on the site. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD
